notes.title: Turkish translation now available
notes.content:
Thanks to [url=https://tr.linkedin.com/company/archura-localization-group]Archura Localization[/url], you can now experience The Elevator Game with Catgirls in Turkish.

Rabia Büyükuğurlu
Yiğit Mehmet Behrem 
Dilan Durmuş

Uğur Gürsoy
Project Manager;
Osman Furkan Uzunoğlu

This is our first time implementing a translation into one of our games! If you encounter any bugs, please let us know.

- Nayru
